title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 研究持续深化资本市场投融资综合改革
title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Deepening Capital Market Investment and Financing Reform
summary_zh: 11月27日，李强主持召开国务院常务会议，听取高质量发展综合督查情况汇报，研究深化资本市场投融资综合改革及国家标准体系建设。
summary_en: On Nov 27, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on high-quality development inspections, capital market investment and financing reform, and national standards.
